header.running_head: Rasulullaah ﷺ Consults with knowledgeable People

blocks.text: this out of compassion for us, then by Allaah, there was a time when they and us were on an equal footing. They were then unable to take a single date from us unless it was bought or given as a token of hospitality." Rasulullaah ﷺ then said to them, "It is as you say (I am doing this out of compassion for you)." Rasulullaah ﷺ then addressed Haarith (and those with him) and said, "You have heard what they have to say." Haarith (and the others) glowered, "You have betrayed us, O Muhammad!" [^1]
Hadhrat Musaddad reports from Hadhrat Umar (RA) that he would also be present when Rasulullaah ﷺ would spend nights discussing the affairs of the Muslims with Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA). [^2]
Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) Consults with Men of knowledge
Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) Consults with Men of Knowledge and Insight who Constituted the Consultative Assembly During his Period and the Period of Hadhrat Umar (RA)

Hadhrat Qaasim narrates that whenever a matter arose and Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) needed to consult with men of knowledge and wisdom, he would summon certain men from the Muhaajireen and the Ansaar. They included Hadhrat Umar (RA), Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA), Hadhrat Ali (RA), Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan bin Auf (RA), Hadhrat Mu'aadh bin Jabal (RA), Hadhrat Ubay bin Ka'b (RA) and Hadhrat Zaid bin Thaabit (RA). These men used to issue Fataawaa (rulings) during his period and people would go to them for rulings. The period of Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) passed like this, and when Hadhrat Umar (RA) became the Khalifah afterwards, he also used to summon these men. When Hadhrat Umar (RA) was the Khalifah, the task of issuing Fataawaa was entrusted to Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA), Hadhrat Ubay (RA) and Hadhrat Zaid (RA). [^3]
The Incident Between Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) and Hadhrat Umar (RA) Concerning the Demarcation of Land for Certain Sahabah (RA)

Hadhrat Ubaydah reports that Uyayna bin Hisn and Aqra bin Haabis once approached Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) saying, "O successor of Rasulullaah ﷺ! There is a barren piece of land in our area that bears no grass and is useless. If you see it fit, do make it over to us so that we may work on it and cultivate it." Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) decided to make it over to them and had the title deed written in their favour. He appointed Hadhrat Umar (RA) as witness to the
Tabraani. Haythami (Vol.6 Pg.132) has commented on the chain of narrators.
